answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 9006 Country: India Title: For the contraction of mosque,can we take donation from the gamling business. Question: For the contraction of mosque,can we take donation from the gamling business. Answer ID: 9006 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2203/1796=B/1429) Mosque is a holy and sacred place; it should be constructed with halal and pure money. We are prohibited to use haram money in building a mosque. It is mentioned in Hadith that Allah is pure and He likes purity. Therefore, constructing mosque with gambling money is not allowed as per the Shariah: عن أب ي ھریرۃ قال: قال رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم: من تصدق بعدل تمرۃ من کسب طیب ولا یقبل اللہ إلا الطیب (مشكاة 167, باب فضل الصدقۃ ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
